why: Two things change. The up-arrows grow: 2, 2, 3, so next 4 up-arrows. The extra arrow at the front turns 90 degrees clockwise: right, down, so next it points left. Option 3 has a left arrow and four up-arrows. Option 4 has 5 arrows but mixed up and down.
trick: Split the figure into parts: one part may count up while another part turns.
note: Up-arrow count 2,2,3,4 is not a perfectly clean rule, but the turning front arrow clearly gives option 3.
